when.en: The approved structure of a surface stays; only typography, spacing, labels, controls, states, tokens or Grammar conformance inside it are repaired.
when.vi: Cấu trúc đã duyệt của bề mặt giữ nguyên; chỉ sửa typography, spacing, label, control, state, token hay conformance Grammar bên trong.

mission.goal: a surface is repaired inside its approved structure, proven and published

doneWhen.evidence: the surface is committed on the session branch
the committed head is served on the product port
the served surface passes the audit with its screenshots kept
a person's journey completes on the served surface
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: frontend trio → interface.generate (changeLevel refine); post-write bind → runtime.serve; frontend.surface.audit → interface.audit.
